responsibility: Defines the central PA-RISC target description macros that parameterize GCC around the PA architecture. It establishes target feature defaults, ABI and object-format flags, debugging behavior, assembler syntax, jump-table and data-output conventions, operand/address printing, return-address handling, TLS and exec-stack capabilities, long-call limits, and numerous backend-wide policy macros that pa.cc, pa.md, and OS-specific companion headers build upon.
same_name_distinction: Central PA macro header: unlike pa.cc it declares backend-wide constants/macros rather than implementing hook code, unlike pa.md it does not define instruction patterns, and unlike pa.opt it does not describe user options.
